events.title: Somalia: Humanitarian aid cuts leave millions of children vulnerable to hunger
events.summary: The global funding crisis for humanitarian work is taking a growing toll on the most vulnerable children in Somalia, where some aid programmes and facilities have been forced to shut down.

events.title: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
events.summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes killed 17 people and injured more than 40 in and around the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Thursday, local authorities reported.

events.title: Middle East: 94 per cent need shelter in Gaza, Israel ramps up demolitions in Lebanon
events.summary: Ninety-four cent of Gaza’s 2.1 million residents need shelter as Israeli gunfire and strikes continue inside the enclave, UN agencies and peacekeepers warned on Thursday.

events.title: As elections near, South Sudan risks new atrocity crimes, warns rights probe
events.summary: The under-reported humanitarian crisis in South Sudan risks deepening with the real possibility of further atrocity crimes unless renewed fighting stops, a UN-backed probe said on Thursday.

events.title: Lebanon: 860,000 displaced people have returned home, but humanitarian crisis remains ‘immense’
events.summary: Around 860,000 people displaced by the conflict in southern Lebanon have returned, but the displacement and humanitarian crisis are “far from over,” the UN warned on Tuesday.

events.title: Gaza: Only three per cent of cropland available to grow food
events.summary: Amid ongoing deadly hostilities in Gaza, the enclave’s farmers face the increasingly difficult challenge of finding safe land to grow their crops.

events.summary: Escalating conflict in Yemen is killing and injuring a growing number of civilians, the UN human rights chief warned on Monday, as Houthi rebels also strike Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping linked to the wider Iran–US confrontation.

events.title: First Person: Syrians lead efforts to clear rubble and rebuild lives
events.summary: Communities in Syria are clearing rubble and rebuilding neighbourhoods and livelihoods torn down in the more than a decade of conflict and crisis in the country.

events.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo

events.summary: Sudanese women about to give birth are losing their babies and sometimes their own lives because of a lack of specialist healthcare support, amid the ongoing war, UN humanitarians said on Friday.

events.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July, with more people killed and injured than at any time since March 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in the country, HRMMU, said in an update on Thursday.

events.summary: In the occupied West Bank, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, appealed on Thursday to Israeli authorities to help Palestinian families trapped in their homes by settlers for days, amid an intensifying campaign to seize their land.

events.title: Sudan: Attacks and further displacement in Blue Nile and North Kordofan

events.title: South Sudan: UN mission decries deadly attacks, works to calm tensions after ‘nothing but devastation’
events.summary: The UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) has condemned recent armed group attacks in Warrap state which reportedly left more than 60 civilians dead and 50 others injured.

events.title: Fighting deepens needs and fuels further displacement in Sudan
events.summary: Ongoing conflict, displacement and funding shortages continue to deepen needs in Sudan, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Monday, underscoring the need for greater civilian protection.

events.title: ‘Sudan is losing another generation’ to war, Mohammed warns
events.summary: More than 1,000 days of war in Sudan have left millions of children out of school, displaced or exposed to grave violations, the UN Deputy Secretary-General said on Friday, calling for renewed action to end the conflict.
